name: ibo-co-pharmacy
description: IBO & CO pharmacy web app 2.0 - React, TypeScript, Node.js/Express and MySQL

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c red,blue "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
